svg.title: Map of client.exe by address
svg.desc: The executable .text in address order, coloured by what is rebuilt, with a table per library region.

g.text: E&B's own code: 0x401000-0x8C1B50 (4,866 KB), reached through the thunk table
Region boundaries follow the runs of proven functions in docs/data (docs/binary.md section 2). Each column is the share of the region's bytes.
